L4·N676unmasked layer

L4·N6256unmasked layer
Fires on the token that **completes a multi-token proper noun or compound word** — the second piece of British brand/place/person names and split words (Sky, Hanworth Villa, Martin Lewis, El-"is"-abeth, J-"umper") — i.e., a name-continuation subword position rather than any semantic category; mid-name fragments that don't finish the name (Car-"is"-brooke, Dun-"fer"-mline, Marg-"are"-tsbury) drive it strongly negative.

Fires on word-internal continuation fragments — sub-word pieces that complete a longer/compound or numeric-abbreviated expression (e.g. "grav" in "aggravated", "reg" in "Fabreguettes", "x" in a phone extension, "4" in "24/7", "-hour" in "60-hour"); notably, similar continuation pieces ("-way" in "half-way", "st" in "1st", "CS" in "NRCS") drive it strongly negative, so it is a surface-form/token-boundary detector rather than a semantic one.
